verdict.rationale: The agent toolkit's API coverage explicitly lists 'orders...shipment tracking, transaction details' as accessible via pre-built functions, and get_order/get_cart-style endpoints exist for cart state, suggesting some order-status query capability exists in the underlying REST surface. However, all documented toolkit tools (create_order, pay_order, create_shipment, refund/dispute tools) are merchant-side actions, not a documented buyer/agent-facing 'check my order status' or 'track my shipment' capability for the AI-native consumer who placed the order — no explicit tool or flow shows a consumer's agent querying post-purchase status/tracking. Missing for 10: an explicit consumer-facing get-order/tracking tool, evidence of an agent (not merchant) invoking it post-purchase, and any hands-on demonstration of this end-to-end flow.
